description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'DirectoryTest' for testing directory sorting functionality in the 'Todaymade\Daux\Tree' namespace. It includes a data provider with various test cases and a test method that verifies the sorting logic of directory entries.

classes.name: DirectoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests sorting of directory entries using various naming conventions.
